mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP growth rate below 2% quarter-over-quarter indicates weakening economic demand, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production index above 105 signals strong supply-side growth, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1,000,000 units signals weakening demand in the housing market, which negatively impacts related sectors and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals easing monetary policy, which is generally positive for equity markets, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 signals strong labor market conditions, which is positive for consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals weakening consumer demand and labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.
